name: @loom/agent-loop-triage
description: A support-ticket triage agent on the canonical agentLoop$ (ADR 0121): the model is routed through the capability ring, one turn's lookups run in parallel and a flaky one comes back as an isError tool result (a terminal quota error still stops the run), a refund parks on a human approval and resumes in a fresh runtime over the same store without re-running a tool, a consumed failure is never re-run, writeBack (ring / unless / allowDirect) lets the next ticket recall the first, and bare writeBack: true or a response cache without cacheScope is a config error. Offline, scripted model.
